book.name: 2Qorontoose Asaas
book.title: Phawuloosi Qorontoose Asaas Xaafida Nam7anththo Kiita

content: Xoossa maaroteththa daroppe dendidayssan hayssi ha oosozi nuus diza gishshas nuni hidota qanxxoko.

Gido attiin geemara haniza yeellasiza yo7ota nu aggidos; as baleththoko; Xoossa qaalaa wordora walakkoko; hessa histtanaappe tumu yo7ota qonccera yootishe asi wurikka nu gizayssa ekkana mala nunateththaa Xoossa sinth shiishshoos.
Nu Mishiraachcho qaalay gordettikokka izi gordettiday dhayanaytassa.
Xoossa leemiso gidida Kirstoosa bonchcho Mishiraachcho qaalaa poo7oza ha alame asay be7ontta mala hayssa ha alameza xoossi ammanontta asaa wozina muumisides.
Nuni Yesus Kirstoosi Godaa gididayssa sabbakoos attiin nuna sabbakokko; nunikka nu baggara Yesusa gishshas inttes ooththizaadentta gididos.
Kirstoosa sinththan Xoossi ba bonchcho erateththa poo7o nuus immanaas, «Poo7oy dhuman poo7o» gida Xoossi ba poo7o nu wozinan poo7isides.
Gido attiin hayssi gita wolqqay nuus Xoossafe imettides attiin nuuppe gidonttayssa bessana mala hayssi bonchcho miishshay nunan oto misatizayta giddon dees.
Awa baggarakka nuna sugikkoka nuni tinth gi meqqoko; nuus yo7oy tippi giikkoka hidota qanxxoko.
Nu goodettikkoka wora wodhdhi attoko; istti nuna shoci genderisikokka nu dhayokko.
Yesusa de7oy nu asateththaan qonccana mala nuni iza hayqo ubba wode tookki yuuyoos.
Yesusa de7oy hayqqiza nu asateththaan qonccana mala paxa diza nuni ubba wodekka Yesusa gishshas hayqos aadhdhi imettoos.
Hessa gishshas nu hayqos aadhdhi imettishin intte qasse de7on gakkeeta.
Kase Geeshsha Maxaafan xaafettida mala, «Ta ammanida gishshas haasayadis» geetettidayssa nunikka hessa he ammano Ayanan ammaniza gishshas haasayoos.
Gaasoykka Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa hayqoppe denththidayssi nunakka izara issife denththidi inttenara ba sinth shiishshanayssa nu eroos.
Daro asaa gakkishe diza kiyateththi Xoossa bonchchos galata bolla galata gujjana mala hayssi wurikka inttena go7anaas hanides.
Hessa gishshas nu hidota qanxxoko; nuus kare bagga asateththay dhayi dhayi biikkoka nuus gaaththa bagga asateththay gallas gallas ooraxi ooraxi bees.
Hessas ha7i guuththa wodes nuna gakkiza waayey izara giiganaas dandayontta mernaas gidiza bonchchon nuna gaththana.

Hessa gishshas nu tishshi histti xeellizay ha7i ayfen beettiza miishsha bolla gidontta ha7i ayfen beettontta miishsha bolla dees; ha7i beettizayssi izi ha7is xalla; ha7i ayfen beettonttayssi gidikko izi mernaassa.
